# 📋 Serve wine

- **Checklist types:** Bar
- **Area:** Bar/Cheese
- **When:** For every guest requesting wine during a bar shift

## What you need

- 🍷 Wine Cans — Bar/Cheese area. Cans of the Wine of the Day selected on the pairing list.
- 🍷 Wine Cooler — Bar/Cheese area. Insulated cooler used to chill wine cans; its ice is not served to guests.
- 🍷 Pairing List — Bar/Cheese area. Daily music, wine, and cheese pairing selected for the camp event.
- 🍷 Aluminum Can Collection — Bar/Cheese area. Camp collection container for empty aluminum beverage cans only.
- The guest's cup

## Ready before normal use

- **🍷 Wine Cans:** The Wine of the Day cans are available and undamaged.
- **🍷 Wine Cooler:** The cooler is clean, upright, and does not leak.
- **🍷 Pairing List:** The current event's music, wine, and cheese are identified.

## Steps

1. Inspect the guest's valid government-issued photo ID.
   - **IF/THEN:** IF the ID does not show that the guest is at least 21, or the guest has no valid ID, THEN do not serve alcohol.
2. Tell the guest the Wine of the Day and its music and cheese pairing.
3. Ask the guest to hold out their cup.
4. Select an open half-can when one is available; otherwise open a new can.
5. Pour one-half can into the guest's cup.
6. Return any remaining half-can upright to 🍷 Wine Cooler.
7. Crush each empty can.
8. Put each crushed empty can in 🍷 Aluminum Can Collection.

## PASS when

- Every person served showed a valid ID proving an age of at least 21.
- Wine was poured into guest cups; no wine can was handed to a guest.
- Each serving was one-half can.
- Every empty can was crushed and put in aluminum-can collection.

## Finish

- Before marking PASS, return each used item to its location and leave it ready for the next person.
- Collect all MOOP.
- If an item, instruction, or solution is missing or unclear, ask the Dominatrix.

### Leave items ready

- **🍷 Wine Cans:** Unopened cans and any open half-can remain upright in the wine cooler. Empty cans are crushed and in aluminum-can collection.
- **🍷 Wine Cooler:** The cooler is upright and closed. Meltwater is contained and no water has reached the playa.
- **🍷 Pairing List:** The current pairing remains readable at the bar.
- **🍷 Aluminum Can Collection:** The container holds only empty aluminum cans and is not overflowing.

### If an item is not ready

- **🍷 Wine Cans:** Tell the Bar Lead before service begins.
- **🍷 Wine Cooler:** Do not use a leaking cooler. Tell the Bar Lead.
- **🍷 Pairing List:** Ask the Bar Lead for the current pairing before service begins.
- **🍷 Aluminum Can Collection:** Remove non-aluminum material. Empty and recycle accumulated cans; see task 📋 Recycle aluminum cans.

## Who to ask

Bar Lead
